experiments.scope: k = 11; returns the confirmed pair when the algorithm succeeds; trial 0 also re-runs the counted full-scale batch (H2) and aborts on mismatch. Scaled copy of the package algorithm on the exact sha256-r37 family m(g,t): each trial is one scaled group batch of 7 consecutive groups x 52 consecutive counters (364 messages) in the package order; the digest is the declared 16-bit mask (11 bits in round-skip key words d,c,h,g, 5 in a,b,e,f); the key is the first k of the 11 key bits; never-initialised table with seeded garbage, 6-bit TAG, 9-bit index, cold regeneration from the index, cap floor(N^2/2^k)+floor(N^2/2^(k+6))+garbage allowance. Diagnostic only: no full search, 256-bit law or resource-bound proof.
experiments.hypothesis: Pre-registered ideal-random-function prediction for the identical algorithm: success probability 0.6163 (+/-0.0024) per trial, mean 157.8 of 256 trials, 99.9% decision interval [131, 184] (99%: [136, 179]); the counted batch reproduces the reference keys at exactly the charged counts.
